items.prompt: For Q=1000000000 and n=2, which construction meets the intended work bound?

options.why: A per-share loop scales with Q instead of the number of emitted buckets.

options.text: Use divmod once, then emit two bucket quantities.
options.why: The schedule can be constructed in O(n) work without enumerating every share.

options.text: Build an array of one billion share identities first.
options.why: The task needs quantities, not per-share identities or their storage.

options.text: Sort every integer from 0 through Q.
options.why: Ordering share numbers is unrelated to equal time slicing.

items.explanation: The schedule can be constructed in O(n) work without enumerating every share.
